# Canonical vs derived — current stage

**Keep canonical from the Factory snapshot:** `canon/domain/unesco-source.json` and its registered import contract. Do not edit imported source literals.

**Keep derived:** keyword/facet research plans, P3916 candidate mappings, raw Wikidata statements, proposed definitions, research queues, article outlines, HTML/Markdown wiki previews, AI outputs and this still-unapproved editorial scope manifest.

**Future canonical candidates (not now):** reviewed referents/relations, sourced KA assertions and KS records, native event/indicator objects under an approved domain contract, pinned cross-Kristal references.

`docs/00_INTENT_AND_SCOPE.md` and `docs/01_SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY.md` document intent/ownership. In a *separate candidate copy*, `kristal.workspace.json.state_scope` may record the chosen editorial domain, requiring a new build/qualification before publication. Do not treat an old Factory build as current after changing state scope.
